newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF to expand alkylalkanolamine capacity.
newsitem.headline: BASF to expand alkylalkanolamine capacity.

text.p: German chemicals group BASF AG said on Tuesday that it would expand its capacity for producing alkylalkanolamines by 15,000 metric tonnes at its main plant in Ludwigshafen.
In a statement, BASF said that the expansion, for which startup is expected to occur in the first quarter of 1999, would expand the group's total annual output to 40,000 metric tonnes.
Alkylalkanolamines are used in producing fabric softeners and flocculant aids for sewage plants as well as in crop protection agents and pharmaceutical compounds.
